question.gloss: question; matter (pas question = out of the question)

meanings.en: question; issue (pas question! = no way!, out of the question!)
meanings.note: Poser une question means 'to ask a question' (never demander une question). Pas question! is a crisp, idiomatic refusal meaning 'Not a chance! / Out of the question!'.

examples.text: Toucher aux fils sans couper le courant? Pas question!
examples.trans: Touching the wires without shutting off the power? Out of the question!

examples.text: Le client a posé une question sur l'histoire de la maison.
examples.trans: The guest asked a question about the history of the house.

examples.text: Le médecin m'a demandé de remplir un petit questionnaire médical.
examples.trans: The doctor asked me to fill out a short medical questionnaire.

examples.text: Cela ne prend que deux minutes pour répondre à ce questionnaire en ligne.
examples.trans: It only takes two minutes to answer this online survey form.

meanings.note: Waiting line of people ('faire la queue' = stand in line); tail or stem.

examples.text: Avec ce gâteau au miel, la moitié de Lyon fera la queue devant le portail!
examples.trans: With this honey cake, half of Lyon will stand in line outside the gate!

examples.text: Nous avons fait la queue dix minutes devant la boulangerie.
examples.trans: We stood in line for ten minutes outside the bakery.

meanings.note: In qu'est-ce qui, the question expression supplies the subject, and need not refer to a person.

examples.text: La dame qui vend du fromage frais au marché est très sympathique.
examples.trans: The lady who sells fresh cheese at the market is very friendly.

examples.text: Qui a mangé le dernier biscuit au chocolat dans la boîte ronde?
examples.trans: Who ate the last chocolate cookie in the round tin?

meanings.en: savory pastry tart with eggs and cream
meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la quiche', plural 'les quiches').

examples.text: Nous avons commandé une quiche chaude avec une salade.
examples.trans: We ordered a warm quiche with a salad.

examples.text: Elle prépare une délicieuse quiche pour le déjeuner.
examples.trans: She is making a delicious quiche for lunch.

meanings.note: Neighbourhood shop selling tools, screws, and valves.

examples.text: J'ai utilisé la dernière cet hiver. Seule la vieille quincaillerie après le pont vend cette taille.
examples.trans: I used the last one this winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge sells this size.

examples.text: À quelle heure ouvre cette quincaillerie?
examples.trans: What time does that hardware shop open?

examples.text: C'est fait. Maintenant, expliquez-moi comment trouver la quincaillerie.
examples.trans: Got it. Now explain to me how to find the hardware shop.

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le quinoa', plural 'les quinoas').

examples.text: À midi, j'ai préparé une salade de quinoa avec des tomates et de la feta.
examples.trans: At noon, I made a quinoa salad with tomatoes and feta.

examples.text: Rince bien le quinoa à l'eau froide avant de le faire cuire.
examples.trans: Rinse the quinoa well in cold water before cooking it.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la quinzaine', plural 'les quinzaines').

examples.text: Nous partons en vacances à Marseille pendant une quinzaine de jours.
examples.trans: We are going on vacation to Marseille for a fortnight.

examples.text: Il restait encore une quinzaine de clients devant la boulangerie.
examples.trans: There were still about fifteen customers outside the bakery.

examples.text: Quinze ans.
examples.trans: Fifteen years.

examples.text: Il est quinze heures.
examples.trans: It's three p.m.

meanings.note: Descriptive French adjective meaning 'even'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Je t'offre le déjeuner aujourd'hui, comme ça nous sommes quittes!
examples.trans: I'm buying you lunch today, that way we're even!

examples.text: Tiens, je te rends tes dix euros: maintenant, on est quitte.
examples.trans: Here, I'm giving you back your ten euros: now we're square.

meanings.en: to leave someone, to break up with
meanings.note: Elle m'a quitté = she left me.
Always with an object.

examples.text: Il quitte l'agence.
examples.trans: He's leaving the agency.

examples.text: Ne me quitte pas.
examples.trans: Don't leave me.

meanings.note: informal, often at the end: pour faire quoi?, c'est quoi?

examples.text: Quoi, tu n'as pas encore lu le nouveau scénario?
examples.trans: What, you haven't read the new script yet?

examples.text: De quoi est-ce que vous parlez tous les deux?
examples.trans: What are the two of you talking about?

meanings.note: Descriptive French adjective meaning 'daily'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Ma petite marche quotidienne dans le parc me détend après le bureau.
examples.trans: My little daily walk in the park relaxes me after the office.

examples.text: Le vélo est très pratique pour tous mes déplacements quotidiens en ville.
examples.trans: Cycling is very practical for all my everyday trips around town.

meanings.note: Folding flap of an envelope, pouch, pocket, or book dust jacket.

examples.text: Un message secret est caché sous le rabat de l'enveloppe.
examples.trans: A secret message is hidden under the flap of the envelope.

examples.text: Repliez bien le rabat en cuir pour fermer la sacoche.
examples.trans: Fold the leather flap down neatly to close the satchel.

examples.text: Ne fais pas le rabat-joie, viens chanter avec nous autour de la table!
examples.trans: Don't be a killjoy, come sing with us around the table!

examples.text: Je ne veux pas jouer les rabat-joie, mais le dernier bus part dans dix minutes.
examples.trans: I don't want to be a wet blanket, but the last bus leaves in ten minutes.

meanings.note: Quicker path cutting between two streets ('prendre un raccourci').

examples.text: Cette ruelle étroite est le meilleur raccourci vers la place.
examples.trans: This narrow lane is the best shortcut to the square.

examples.text: Les habitants du quartier connaissent tous ce raccourci.
examples.trans: Everyone in the neighborhood knows this shortcut.

meanings.note: Opposite of décrocher. Regular -er verb; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'raccroché').
raccrocher les gants = to hang up the gloves

examples.text: Trop tard! Il a dit merci et il a raccroché!
examples.trans: Too late! He said thank you and hung up!

examples.text: Ne raccroche pas!
examples.trans: Do not hang up!

meanings.note: From racheter.

examples.text: Le rachat de la vieille librairie du quartier a rassuré tous les habitants.
examples.trans: The buyout of the old neighborhood bookstore reassured all the residents.

examples.text: La banque nous a proposé de bonnes conditions pour le rachat de notre crédit.
examples.trans: The bank offered us good terms for refinancing our loan.

meanings.en: to buy back, to buy out
meanings.note: Can mean acquire or buy out a business or shares, as well as buy something back.
Also buy more of something, such as bread.

examples.text: Il n'y a plus de beurre au frigo, je vais en racheter tout à l'heure.
examples.trans: There's no butter left in the fridge, I'll buy some more later.

examples.text: Un jeune couple vient de racheter le petit café en face de la mairie.
examples.trans: A young couple has just bought out the little café across from town hall.

meanings.note: faire ses racines = touch up one's roots
Les racines d'un arbre. Feminine noun ('la racine', plural 'les racines').

examples.text: Je vais chez ma coiffeuse samedi matin pour refaire mes racines.
examples.trans: I'm going to my hairdresser Saturday morning to touch up my roots.

examples.text: Attention de ne pas abîmer les racines en rempotant cette plante verte.
examples.trans: Be careful not to damage the roots when repotting this houseplant.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la raclure', plural 'les raclures').

examples.text: Celui qui a volé le sac de cette vieille dame est une vraie raclure!
examples.trans: Whoever stole that old lady's bag is a total scumbag!

examples.text: Il a rayé ma voiture sur le parking sans laisser de mot: quelle raclure!
examples.trans: He scratched my car in the parking lot without leaving a note: what a scumbag!

meanings.note: qu'est-ce que tu racontes? = what are you talking about?

examples.text: Raconte-moi une histoire.
examples.trans: Tell me a story.

examples.text: Assieds-toi avec nous et raconte-nous ton week-end à la mer!
examples.trans: Sit down with us and tell us all about your weekend at the seaside!

meanings.note: Hot-water room radiator.

examples.text: Touche le radiateur — le bas est chaud, alors que le haut devient froid.
examples.trans: Feel the radiator—the bottom is warm, while the top is turning cool.

examples.text: J'ai posé mes gants mouillés sur le radiateur de l'entrée pour les sécher.
examples.trans: I put my wet gloves on the hall radiator to dry them.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la radio', plural 'les radios').

examples.text: Mon père écoute toujours les informations à la radio en prenant son café.
examples.trans: My father always listens to the news on the radio while having his coffee.

examples.text: Baisse un peu la radio, s'il te plaît, je suis au téléphone.
examples.trans: Turn the radio down a bit, please, I'm on the phone.

meanings.note: Sudden strong gust or squall of wind ('rafale de vent').

examples.text: La météo annonce de vives rafales de vent sur la ville vendredi après-midi.
examples.trans: The weather forecast calls for brisk gusts of wind across town Friday afternoon.

examples.text: Une rafale fraîche vient de s'engouffrer sous le porche en pierre.
examples.trans: A cool gust just swept in beneath the stone archway.

meanings.note: Pleasantly cooling and refreshing in flavor or temperature.

examples.text: Étienne soutient qu'une pointe d'acidité est très rafraîchissante en été.
examples.trans: Étienne insists that a touch of tartness is very refreshing in summer.

examples.text: Une carafe d'eau à la menthe fraîche est toujours rafraîchissante.
examples.trans: A pitcher of fresh mint water is always refreshing.

meanings.note: Inflexible. Descriptive French adjective meaning 'stiff'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: J'ai la nuque toute raide après avoir dormi sur un mauvais oreiller.
examples.trans: My neck is all stiff after sleeping on a bad pillow.

examples.text: La côte derrière l'église est trop raide pour monter à vélo sans s'arrêter.
examples.trans: The hill behind the church is too steep to ride up without stopping.

meanings.note: Avoir raison = to be right.
pour quelle raison? = for what reason?

examples.text: Tu as bien raison, cette soupe de légumes chauds manque de sel.
examples.trans: You are quite right, this hot vegetable soup needs more salt.

examples.text: Pour quelle raison le bus de huit heures ne passe-t-il pas aujourd'hui?
examples.trans: For what reason is the eight o'clock bus not running today?

meanings.note: Sois raisonnable = be reasonable. Adjective of capability/quality formed with '-able'/'-ible' (from Latin '-abilis'/'-ibilis').

examples.text: Les prix de ce petit restaurant de quartier restent très raisonnables.
examples.trans: The prices at this little neighborhood restaurant remain very reasonable.

examples.text: Sois raisonnable: il est minuit et tu dois te lever tôt demain matin.
examples.trans: Be sensible: it's midnight and you have to get up early tomorrow morning.

meanings.en: A family name of Slavic origin encountered in French-speaking contexts.
meanings.note: In French usage, -vski undergoes regressive voiceless assimilation of v before s to f (fski), and spelling j is commonly pronounced ʒ (or occasionally palatal j following Slavic pronunciation).

examples.text: Monsieur Rajevski attend un taxi devant l'hôtel.
examples.trans: Mr. Rajevski is waiting for a taxi in front of the hotel.

examples.text: La table près de la fenêtre est réservée au nom de Rajevski.
examples.trans: The table by the window is reserved under the name Rajevski.

meanings.note: French '-ir' verb (from Latin '-ire') meaning 'to slow down'; essential in everyday spoken and professional French.

examples.text: Les voitures doivent ralentir devant l'école du quartier tous les matins.
examples.trans: Cars must slow down in front of the neighborhood school every morning.

examples.text: Ralentis un peu, je marche lentement avec ces deux gros sacs!
examples.trans: Slow down a bit, I am walking slowly with these two heavy bags!

meanings.note: Built from re- + allumer.

examples.text: Pas une seule goutte! On peut rallumer la chaudière maintenant?
examples.trans: Not a single drop! Can we relight the boiler now?

examples.text: Le vent a soufflé les bougies sur la terrasse, je vais les rallumer.
examples.trans: The wind blew out the candles on the patio, I'll relight them.

rambouillet.gloss: Rambouillet (town and forest southwest of Paris)

meanings.en: A historic town, commune, and extensive forest in the Yvelines department (Île-de-France), southwest of Paris.
meanings.note: Inhabitants are called Rambolitains (masculine) and Rambolitaines (feminine), preserving the medieval Latin stem Rambolit-.

examples.text: Nous allons marcher dans la forêt de Rambouillet samedi.
examples.trans: We are going to walk in the forest of Rambouillet on Saturday.

examples.text: Ce train régional va directement jusqu'à Rambouillet.
examples.trans: This regional train goes directly to Rambouillet.

meanings.note: Stem-changing *-er* verb (*e -> è* when the ending is silent: *je ramène, nous ramenons, je ramènerai*).

examples.text: Les dernières mesures nous ramènent doucement au thème du début.
examples.trans: The final bars gently lead us back to the opening theme.

examples.text: Je ramène les tasses vides à la cuisine après le thé.
examples.trans: I bring the empty cups back to the kitchen after tea.

related.gloss: to go home, to come back

meanings.note: Staircase handrail or balcony railing ('rampe de balcon', 'rampe d'escalier').

examples.text: La rampe du balcon est construite en chêne massif bien sec.
examples.trans: The balcony railing is built of solid seasoned oak.

examples.text: Tenez-vous à la rampe en descendant l'escalier.
examples.trans: Hold on to the banister as you walk down the stairs.

meanings.en: A masculine given name (and surname) of Arabic origin, widely used in North Africa, the Middle East, and France.
meanings.note: Spelled both Ramzy and Ramzi in French; the sequence am is pronounced orally (am) rather than as a nasal vowel.

examples.text: Ramzy apporte des croissants chauds au bureau.
examples.trans: Ramzy brings warm croissants to the office.

examples.text: Où est-ce que Ramzy a garé sa voiture?
examples.trans: Where did Ramzy park his car?

meanings.note: Garder de la rancœur. Feminine noun ('la rancœur', plural 'les rancœurs').

examples.text: Malgré leur vieille dispute, mon oncle parle de lui sans aucune rancœur.
examples.trans: Despite their old argument, my uncle speaks of him without any bitterness.

examples.text: Il vaut mieux s'expliquer calmement plutôt que de garder de la rancœur.
examples.trans: It is better to talk things through calmly rather than hold onto resentment.

meanings.en: hike, ramble, long trek on foot
meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la randonnée', plural 'les randonnées').

examples.text: Dimanche, nous faisons une belle randonnée en forêt avec des amis.
examples.trans: On Sunday, we are going on a lovely hike in the forest with friends.

examples.text: N'oublie pas ta gourde et tes chaussures de randonnée dans le coffre!
examples.trans: Don't forget your water bottle and your hiking boots in the trunk!

meanings.note: Au premier rang = in the front row.

examples.text: Attends vendredi à midi: je veux être au premier rang quand l'homme à la valise entrera!
examples.trans: Wait until Friday at noon: I want a front-row seat when Suitcase Man walks in!

examples.text: Range tes oignons en rangs bien droits dans le potager.
examples.trans: Plant your onions in neat straight rows in the vegetable garden.

ranger.gloss: to put away, tidy up, store neatly

meanings.en: to put away, store, tidy up
meanings.note: Essential French household verb (with no single-word English twin) meaning both 'put something in its proper place' and 'tidy a room'. Keeps -ge- before a/o: nous rangeons.

examples.text: On plie les chaises et on les range au sec sous l'arche.
examples.trans: We fold the chairs and store them somewhere dry under the archway.

examples.text: Henri range toujours chaque outil à sa place après usage.
examples.trans: Henri always puts every tool back in its place after using it.

meanings.note: Adjective (*un rythme rapide*, 'a fast rhythm'), whereas *vite* is normally an adverb ('quickly').

examples.text: Le premier mouvement est vif et rapide, puis la musique ralentit.
examples.trans: The first movement is bright and fast, then the music slows down.

examples.text: C'est une recette rapide pour le déjeuner de midi.
examples.trans: It's a quick recipe for midday lunch.

meanings.note: Manner adverb formed by adding '-ment' (from Latin 'mente', 'with a . mind') to the feminine adjective stem.

examples.text: Habille-toi rapidement, sinon on va manquer le bus de huit heures!
examples.trans: Get dressed quickly, or we're going to miss the eight o'clock bus!

examples.text: La pluie s'est arrêtée rapidement et le soleil est revenu avant midi.
examples.trans: The rain stopped quickly and the sun came back out before noon.

meanings.en: to call back, to phone again
meanings.note: Rappeler quelque chose à quelqu'un.

examples.text: Je vous rappelle dans dix minutes.
examples.trans: I'll call you back in ten minutes.

examples.text: Rappelle la gare, s'il te plaît.
examples.trans: Call the station back, please.

meanings.note: avoir un rapport avec = to be related to

examples.text: Ce plat simple offre le meilleur rapport qualité-prix de tout le café.
examples.trans: This simple dish offers the best value for money in the whole café.

examples.text: Mon frère doit finir d'écrire son rapport au bureau avant vendredi soir.
examples.trans: My brother has to finish writing his report at the office before Friday evening.

meanings.note: Built from re- + apporter.

examples.text: Pas une seule fissure! Qui l'a rapportée?
examples.trans: Not a single crack! Who brought it back?

examples.text: Voici cinquante euros de la caisse. Rapportez le ticket!
examples.trans: Here is fifty euros from the cash box. Bring back the receipt!

meanings.note: Rapprocher deux personnes. Regular -er verb; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'rapproché').
Reflexive. Regular -er verb; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'rapproché').

examples.text: Rapproche ta chaise de la table pour que tout le monde ait de la place.
examples.trans: Pull your chair closer to the table so that everyone has room.

examples.text: Les vacances d'été se rapprochent enfin, j'ai hâte de partir!
examples.trans: Summer vacation is finally drawing closer, I can't wait to leave!

meanings.note: Scarce or uncommon; the singular form is the same for either gender.

examples.text: Il est rare de voir autant de neige à Bordeaux au mois de mars.
examples.trans: It is rare to see so much snow in Bordeaux in March.

examples.text: Un commerçant aussi souriant dès sept heures du matin, cela devient rare!
examples.trans: A shopkeeper that cheerful at seven in the morning is getting rare!

meanings.note: Rarely or seldom; contrasts with souvent, often.

examples.text: Je prends rarement ma voiture pour aller travailler dans le centre-ville.
examples.trans: I rarely take my car to go to work downtown.

examples.text: Ma grand-mère sort rarement le soir quand il fait nuit tôt.
examples.trans: My grandmother rarely goes out in the evening when it gets dark early.

meanings.note: se raser la barbe = to shave one's beard

examples.text: Mon frère se rase devant le miroir de la salle de bain tous les matins.
examples.trans: My brother shaves in front of the bathroom mirror every morning.

examples.text: Il a décidé de raser sa barbe pour l'été parce qu'il avait trop chaud.
examples.trans: He decided to shave off his beard for the summer because he was too hot.

meanings.en: to bring together, gather (people or objects)
meanings.note: Built from re- + assembler; warm verb for a place or tradition that brings neighbours together.

examples.text: Le thé du vendredi rassemblait tous les habitants de la rue.
examples.trans: Friday tea used to bring together everyone on the street.

examples.text: Claire rassemble les cartes postales sur le comptoir.
examples.trans: Claire gathers the postcards together on the counter.

meanings.note: Makes someone feel calmer or less worried; feminine rassurante pronounces the t.

examples.text: Le sourire calme du médecin était très rassurant pour toute la famille.
examples.trans: The doctor's calm smile was very reassuring for the whole family.

examples.text: C'est rassurant de savoir que la pharmacie de garde reste ouverte toute la nuit.
examples.trans: It is reassuring to know that the on-duty pharmacy stays open all night.

meanings.en: to reassure, comfort, put at ease
meanings.note: se rassurer = to reassure oneself, calm down

examples.text: Rassurez-vous! Nous avons préparé notre chambre calme sous les toits juste pour vous.
examples.trans: Rest assured! We prepared our quiet attic room just for you.

examples.text: Rassure-toi, tout va bien.
examples.trans: Don't worry, everything is fine.

examples.text: Rassurez-vous!
examples.trans: Rest assured!

meanings.note: A train, a plane, an opportunity.
Informal.

examples.text: Dépêche-toi de mettre tes chaussures sinon nous allons rater notre train!
examples.trans: Hurry up and put your shoes on or we are going to miss our train!

examples.text: J'ai complètement raté ma mayonnaise maison parce que l'huile était trop froide.
examples.trans: I completely messed up my homemade mayonnaise because the oil was too cold.

rattraper.gloss: to catch up on, to make up for

meanings.en: to catch up on, to make up for
meanings.note: rattraper le retard = to catch up on the delay

examples.text: Il court vite sur le trottoir pour rattraper le bus du matin.
examples.trans: He runs fast down the sidewalk to catch up with the morning bus.

examples.text: Je vais faire une longue sieste dimanche pour rattraper mon sommeil perdu.
examples.trans: I am going to take a long nap on Sunday to catch up on my lost sleep.

related.gloss: to catch up on the delay

meanings.note: Feminine: ratée. Masculine noun ('le raté', plural 'les ratés').

examples.text: Ne te traite pas de raté juste parce que ton entretien s'est mal passé.
examples.trans: Don't call yourself a failure just because your interview went badly.

examples.text: Après avoir perdu son emploi, il avait peur de passer pour un raté.
examples.trans: After losing his job, he was afraid of coming across as a loser.

meanings.note: Ravi de plus infinitive: delighted to do something.

examples.text: Elle est ravie de venir.
examples.trans: She's delighted to come.

examples.text: Nous sommes ravis que notre cour soit paisible pour votre... travail.
examples.trans: We are delighted that our courtyard is peaceful for your... work.

meanings.note: Descriptive French adjective meaning 'ravishing'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Ta sœur porte une robe fleurie vraiment ravissante aujourd'hui!
examples.trans: Your sister is wearing a truly lovely floral dress today!

examples.text: Nous avons loué une ravissante petite maison en pierre près de la plage.
examples.trans: We rented a charming little stone house near the beach.

meanings.en: A given name (predominantly masculine in France) of Arabic origin meaning "lush, flourishing, quenched".
meanings.note: In French orthography, the final silent -e ensures that the preceding -n is pronounced as an oral consonant (ʁajan) rather than nasalizing the vowel into -an (ɑ̃).

examples.text: Rayane révise ses cours à la bibliothèque municipale.
examples.trans: Rayane is reviewing his lessons at the public library.

examples.text: Nous retrouvons Rayane au parc après le déjeuner.
examples.trans: We are meeting Rayane at the park after lunch.

meanings.en: to scratch, cross off, strike out
meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to scratch'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'rayé').

examples.text: Attention à ne pas rayer la table neuve avec tes clés!
examples.trans: Be careful not to scratch the new table with your keys!

examples.text: Elle raye sur sa liste chaque produit qu'elle met dans son panier.
examples.trans: She crosses off her list each item she puts into her basket.

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le rayon', plural 'les rayons').

examples.text: Excusez-moi, à quel rayon se trouvent les pâtes et le riz?
examples.trans: Excuse me, which aisle are the pasta and rice in?

examples.text: Je passe toujours un long moment au rayon des romans policier à la librairie.
examples.trans: I always spend a long time in the mystery section at the bookstore.

meanings.note: Descriptive French adjective meaning 'radiant'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Ma mère était rayonnante en revenant de sa semaine au bord de la mer.
examples.trans: My mother was glowing when she got back from her week by the sea.

examples.text: Les jeunes mariés avaient un visage rayonnant en sortant de la mairie.
examples.trans: The newlyweds had beaming faces as they walked out of town hall.

meanings.note: Fine scratch on glass or metal; woven or painted stripe ('à rayures' = striped).

examples.text: Le verre de la boussole n'a pas la moindre rayure.
examples.trans: The glass of the compass doesn't have a single scratch.

examples.text: Il porte un tablier en coton bleu à rayures blanches.
examples.trans: He wears a blue cotton apron with white stripes.

meanings.note: Patterned with stripes ('une boîte à chapeau rayée' = a striped hatbox), or scratched.

examples.text: Ne vous inquiétez pas, Odette; voici la boîte à chapeau rayée bien en sécurité devant la chambre six!
examples.trans: Do not worry, Odette; here sits the striped hatbox safe and sound outside Room Six!

examples.text: Le boulanger porte un grand tablier rayé bleu et blanc.
examples.trans: The baker wears a large blue-and-white striped apron.

meanings.en: A feminine given name of Biblical Hebrew origin, borne in French as either Rebecca or Rébecca.
meanings.note: Even when written without an acute accent on the first e (Rebecca), standard French pronounces the initial syllable with a closed vowel e (ʁebeka) rather than schwa.

examples.text: Rebecca boit un thé vert avant de partir travailler.
examples.trans: Rebecca drinks a green tea before leaving for work.

examples.text: As-tu déjà envoyé l'adresse du restaurant à Rebecca?
examples.trans: Have you already sent the restaurant's address to Rebecca?

meanings.note: French relational/descriptive adjective derived from Latin adjectival roots. Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity.

examples.text: J'ai toujours une mèche rebelle qui se dresse sur ma tête au réveil.
examples.trans: I always have an unruly lock of hair sticking up on my head when I wake up.

examples.text: À quinze ans, ma nièce traverse une petite période rebelle à la maison.
examples.trans: At fifteen, my niece is going through a little rebellious phase at home.

meanings.note: After a failure.

examples.text: Le petit garçon fait rebondir son ballon rouge dans la cour de l'école.
examples.trans: The little boy is bouncing his red ball in the schoolyard.

examples.text: Après la fermeture de sa boutique, elle a su rebondir très vite.
examples.trans: After her shop closed down, she managed to bounce back very quickly.

meanings.note: Friendly greeting on seeing someone a second time that day.

examples.text: Rebonjour, j'ai oublié de prendre une baguette bien cuite tout à l'heure!
examples.trans: Hello again, I forgot to get a well-baked baguette earlier!

examples.text: La boulangère m'a dit rebonjour avec le sourire quand je suis revenu.
examples.trans: The baker said hello again with a smile when I came back.

meanings.note: Raised rim of a fountain basin, windowsill ('rebord de fenêtre'), or stone ledge.

examples.text: Un chat roux dort au soleil sur le rebord de la fenêtre.
examples.trans: A ginger cat sleeps in the sun on the windowsill.

examples.text: Elle s'assoit un moment sur le rebord frais du bassin.
examples.trans: She sits for a moment on the cool rim of the fountain basin.

meanings.en: reverse order (in compte à rebours = countdown; à rebours = backwards)
meanings.note: Final -s is silent (/ʁəbuʁ/). Almost always met in un compte à rebours ('a countdown') and à rebours ('backwards, against the grain').

examples.text: À cinq jours de l'ouverture, le compte à rebours est lancé!
examples.trans: With five days until opening, the countdown is on!

examples.text: Tout le monde compte à rebours avant d'allumer la guirlande.
examples.trans: Everyone counts down before switching on the string of lights.

meanings.note: Culinary recipe; box-office or shop takings.

examples.text: Cette recette de tarte aux amandes se transmet dans la famille.
examples.trans: This almond tart recipe has been passed down in the family.

examples.text: Elle a noté toute la recette à la plume sur un bristol.
examples.trans: She wrote down the whole recipe in fountain pen on a note card.

meanings.note: Cedilla *ç* appears before *o* and *u* (*je reçois, j'ai reçu*) to keep the soft `/s/` sound.

examples.text: Nous avons reçu douze assiettes blanches ce matin.
examples.trans: We received twelve white plates this morning.

examples.text: Chaque plante du jardin reçoit la lumière du matin.
examples.trans: Every garden plant gets the morning light.

meanings.note: Une pièce / vanne de rechange = a spare part / valve.

examples.text: Vous avez une vanne de rechange dans votre caisse à outils?
examples.trans: Do you have a spare valve in your toolbox?

examples.text: Prends un tee-shirt de rechange dans ton sac à dos au cas où il pleuvrait.
examples.trans: Pack a spare T-shirt in your backpack in case it rains.

meanings.en: faire des recherches = to do research, to read up
meanings.note: À la recherche de.

examples.text: J'ai fait des recherches.
examples.trans: I did some research.

examples.text: La recherche d'un appartement calme à Paris demande beaucoup de patience.
examples.trans: Searching for a quiet apartment in Paris takes a lot of patience.

rechercher.gloss: to seek out, to look for

meanings.en: to seek out, to look for, to be in high demand
meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to seek out'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'recherché').

examples.text: Les bons boulangers sont très recherchés dans toute notre région.
examples.trans: Good bakers are in high demand throughout our region.

examples.text: Nous recherchons un petit hôtel tranquille pas trop loin de la gare.
examples.trans: We are looking for a quiet little hotel not too far from the station.

meanings.note: Lettre recommandée = registered letter.

examples.text: Pire qu'un tuyau... une lettre recommandée du propriétaire de l'immeuble est arrivée à midi.
examples.trans: Worse than a pipe... a registered letter from the building owner arrived at noon.

examples.text: Je vous recommande la tarte au citron maison: elle est délicieuse!
examples.trans: I recommend the homemade lemon tart to you: it's delicious!

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le recommandé', plural 'les recommandés').

examples.text: Une lettre recommandée est arrivée.
examples.trans: A registered letter arrived.

examples.text: un recommandé.
examples.trans: a registered letter.

recommencer.gloss: to start again, to do again

meanings.en: to start again, to begin again
meanings.note: nous recommençons takes ç before -ons

examples.text: J'ai fait une faute sur le chèque, je dois tout recommencer.
examples.trans: I made a mistake on the check, I have to start all over again.

examples.text: Attention, il recommence à pleuvoir: rentrons vite le linge sec!
examples.trans: Watch out, it's starting to rain again: let's bring the dry laundry inside quickly!

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la reconnaissance', plural 'les reconnaissances').

examples.text: Elle a offert des fleurs à la voisine pour lui montrer toute sa reconnaissance.
examples.trans: She gave the neighbor flowers to show her deep gratitude.

examples.text: Ils sont allés à la mairie signer l'acte de reconnaissance de leur bébé.
examples.trans: They went to town hall to sign the legal recognition certificate for their baby.

meanings.note: Third-group irregular verb inherited from core Latin roots ('-ere'). Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Core French verb meaning 'to recognize'.

examples.text: On apprend à reconnaître l'intérêt.
examples.trans: One learns to recognize interest.

examples.text: Je ne t'avais pas reconnu de loin avec ton nouveau manteau vert!
examples.trans: I didn't recognize you from afar in your new green coat!

meanings.note: French '-ir' verb (from Latin '-ire') meaning 'to win back'; essential in everyday spoken and professional French.

examples.text: Il fait tout pour reconquérir le cœur de sa femme.
examples.trans: He is doing everything to win back his wife's heart.

examples.text: Ce rôle va lui permettre de reconquérir son public.
examples.trans: This role will allow him to win back his audience.

meanings.note: To copy a list, recipe, or seating plan neatly onto another sheet or notebook.

examples.text: Claire propose de recopier les vingt-huit places dans le grand cahier.
examples.trans: Claire offers to copy the twenty-eight seats into the big ledger.

examples.text: J'ai recopié la vieille recette sur une fiche en bristol neuve.
examples.trans: I recopied the old recipe onto a new index card.

meanings.note: Recruter un candidat. Regular -er verb; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'recruté').

examples.text: Le supermarché du coin recrute deux caissiers pour la saison d'été.
examples.trans: The corner supermarket is hiring two cashiers for the summer season.

examples.text: Notre bureau cherche à recruter un nouveau comptable avant septembre.
examples.trans: Our office is looking to recruit a new accountant before September.

meanings.note: prendre du recul = to take a step back / gain perspective
Le recul d'une arme. Masculine noun ('le recul', plural 'les reculs').

examples.text: Recule d'un pas pour avoir assez de recul devant ce grand tableau.
examples.trans: Step back a pace so you have enough distance in front of this large painting.

examples.text: Avec un peu de recul, je comprends beaucoup mieux la décision de mes parents.
examples.trans: With a bit of perspective, I understand my parents' decision much better.

reculer.gloss: to back up, retreat, shrink back

meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to shrink back'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'reculé').

examples.text: Peux-tu reculer ta chaise d'un pas pour laisser passer le serveur?
examples.trans: Can you move your chair back a step to let the waiter pass?

examples.text: La voiture blanche recule doucement pour sortir de la cour étroite.
examples.trans: The white car backs up slowly to pull out of the narrow courtyard.

redemander.gloss: to ask for more, ask again

meanings.en: to ask for more, ask again
meanings.note: 'redemander de' = to ask for a second helping of food or drink.

examples.text: Même notre juge sévère est en train de redemander une part de gâteau!
examples.trans: Even our strict judge is asking for a second slice of cake!

examples.text: Le gâteau était si bon que tout le monde en a redemandé.
examples.trans: The cake was so good that everyone asked for seconds.

meanings.en: to become again, return to being
meanings.note: reprendre son état antérieur; uses être as auxiliary

examples.text: Après le passage de l'orage, le ciel redevient tout bleu au-dessus du parc.
examples.trans: After the storm passes, the sky turns completely blue again above the park.

examples.text: Dès que les enfants dorment, la maison redevient enfin silencieuse.
examples.trans: As soon as the children are asleep, the house finally becomes quiet again.

meanings.note: redonner confiance = to restore confidence

examples.text: Cela m'a redonné le sourire.
examples.trans: That brought back my smile.

examples.text: Une bonne sieste à l'ombre va te redonner de l'énergie pour ce soir.
examples.trans: A good nap in the shade will give you back some energy for tonight.

meanings.note: Adjective of capability/quality formed with '-able'/'-ible' (from Latin '-abilis'/'-ibilis'). Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity.

examples.text: Ma grand-mère est une joueuse de cartes absolument redoutable le dimanche!
examples.trans: My grandmother is an absolutely formidable card player on Sundays!

examples.text: Le verglas sur les trottoirs rend la descente de la rue redoutable ce matin.
examples.trans: The black ice on the sidewalks makes walking down the street treacherous this morning.

meanings.note: Built from re- + dresser.

examples.text: Le fil avait besoin d'être redressé, c'est tout. Rien de sentimental dans le bon entretien.
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening, that is all. Nothing sentimental about good maintenance.

examples.text: Attends, je vais redresser ce cadre sur le mur: il penche à gauche.
examples.trans: Wait, I'm going to straighten that picture frame on the wall: it's leaning to the left.

refermer.gloss: to close again, shut back up

meanings.en: to close again, shut back up
meanings.note: Built from re- + fermer.

examples.text: Vite, refermez-le! Montons-le tout de suite... attendez, c'est quoi ce grand bruit métallique?
examples.trans: Quick, close it! Let us take it upstairs right away... wait, what is that loud metallic noise?

examples.text: Pense à bien refermer le pot de confiture après le petit déjeuner.
examples.trans: Remember to close the jam jar tightly after breakfast.

meanings.en: to pass off, dump on someone, palm off (colloquial)
meanings.note: refiler qc à qqn = to pass something off onto someone

examples.text: Mon collègue m'a refilé son gros rhume la semaine dernière au bureau!
examples.trans: My coworker gave me his bad cold last week at the office!

examples.text: Il essaie toujours de refiler les corvées de ménage à son petit frère.
examples.trans: He always tries to pawn the household chores off on his little brother.

related.gloss: to pass something off onto someone

meanings.note: Un reflet sur la vitre = a reflection on the windowpane.

examples.text: Le soleil laisse un reflet doré sur le verre dépoli.
examples.trans: The sun leaves a golden reflection on the frosted glass.

examples.text: Le petit chat regarde son propre reflet dans la flaque d'eau avec surprise.
examples.trans: The kitten looks at its own reflection in the puddle in surprise.

meanings.en: to cool down, get cold, chill
meanings.note: French '-ir' verb (from Latin '-ire') meaning 'to cool down'; essential in everyday spoken and professional French.

examples.text: La soupe commence à refroidir.
examples.trans: The soup is beginning to get cold.

examples.text: Il refroidit sur la grille en ce moment: croûte dorée et bon parfum de citron!
examples.trans: It is cooling on the rack right now: golden crust and lovely lemon scent!

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le refuge', plural 'les refuges').

examples.text: Nous avons adopté notre chien dans un refuge pour animaux l'an dernier.
examples.trans: We adopted our dog from an animal shelter last year.

examples.text: Quand l'averse a commencé, les randonneurs ont dormi dans un refuge de montagne.
examples.trans: When the downpour started, the hikers slept in a mountain hut.

meanings.note: final s is silent; same form in the plural

examples.text: Malgré le refus de la banque, ils cherchent une autre solution pour leur maison.
examples.trans: Despite the bank's refusal, they are looking for another solution for their house.

examples.text: J'ai invité ma voisine à prendre le thé, mais j'ai essuyé un refus poli.
examples.trans: I invited my neighbor over for tea, but I met with a polite refusal.

meanings.note: Être refusé(e) = to be turned down.

examples.text: Elle refuse le rôle.
examples.trans: She turns down the part.

examples.text: Il est refusé.
examples.trans: He's turned down.

meanings.en: look, gaze, expression in the eyes

examples.text: Mon chien me lance un regard triste chaque fois que je prends mes clés.
examples.trans: My dog gives me a sad look every time I pick up my keys.

examples.text: Elle a croisé le regard d'un vieil ami sur le quai du métro.
examples.trans: She caught an old friend's eye on the subway platform.

meanings.note: no preposition needed: regarder la photo
A film, the TV.

examples.text: Regarde bien cette photo sur la première page!
examples.trans: Look closely at this photo on the front page!

examples.text: Nous allons regarder les premiers essais cet après-midi.
examples.trans: We are going to watch the first screen tests this afternoon.

meanings.note: Le registre des réservations = the reservation ledger.

examples.text: Henri note chaque arrivée à l'encre dans son grand registre.
examples.trans: Henri writes every arrival in ink in his big ledger.

examples.text: Fermez le registre du soir avant d'éteindre la lampe.
examples.trans: Close the evening register before turning off the lamp.

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le regret', plural 'les regrets').

examples.text: Nous avons quitté notre petit village d'enfance avec beaucoup de regret.
examples.trans: We left our little childhood village with great regret.

examples.text: Prends une part de gâteau au chocolat maintenant, sinon tu auras des regrets!
examples.trans: Have a slice of chocolate cake now, or you'll have regrets!

meanings.en: to regret, to be sorry for

examples.text: Je regrette d'avoir acheté cette veste trop légère pour l'automne.
examples.trans: I regret buying this jacket that's too light for autumn.

examples.text: Depuis son déménagement à Lyon, elle regrette parfois le calme de la campagne.
examples.trans: Since moving to Lyon, she sometimes misses the quiet of the countryside.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la reine', plural 'les reines').

examples.text: Elle joue le rôle de la reine dans ce film historique.
examples.trans: She plays the role of the queen in this historical film.

examples.text: Sur le plateau, cette grande actrice est traitée comme une reine.
examples.trans: On set, this great actress is treated like a queen.

meanings.note: Rejeter une offre. Regular -er verb; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'rejeté').
Rejeter. Regular -er verb; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'rejeté').

examples.text: La mairie a rejeté le projet de parking devant le jardin public.
examples.trans: Town hall rejected the plan for a parking lot in front of the public park.

examples.text: La mer a rejeté plein de coquillages blancs sur le sable après la tempête.
examples.trans: The sea washed lots of white shells up onto the sand after the storm.

meanings.note: To catch up or meet up with someone; for two paths or lines to meet ('se rejoindre').

examples.text: Je vous rejoins sur la place dès que le four est éteint.
examples.trans: I'll meet you on the square as soon as the oven is off.

examples.text: Les deux allées ombragées se rejoignent devant la fontaine.
examples.trans: The two shaded paths meet in front of the fountain.

related.gloss: to get back, recover, find again

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le relais', plural 'les relais').

examples.text: Je conduis depuis trois heures: veux-tu prendre le relais après la pause?
examples.trans: I've been driving for three hours: do you want to take over the wheel after the break?

examples.text: L'infirmière de nuit vient prendre le relais dans le service à vingt heures.
examples.trans: The night nurse comes to take over the shift on the ward at eight p.m.

meanings.note: Une relation entre deux personnes.
Avoir des relations.

examples.text: Mon frère entretient une très belle relation de confiance avec ses enfants.
examples.trans: My brother maintains a wonderful relationship of trust with his children.

examples.text: Grâce à ses relations dans le quartier, elle a vite trouvé un bon plombier.
examples.trans: Thanks to her connections in the neighborhood, she quickly found a good plumber.

relever.gloss: to get back up ('se relever'); to lift up

meanings.en: to lift up; reflexive *se relever*: to get back up, stand back up
meanings.note: Stem changes *e -> è* before silent endings (*ne te relève pas!*, 'don't get back up!').

examples.text: Reste assis une minute, ne te relève pas trop vite.
examples.trans: Stay seated for a minute, don't get back up too fast.

examples.text: Il relève doucement le couvercle en bois du piano.
examples.trans: He gently lifts up the wooden piano lid.

meanings.note: avoir du relief = to have character/depth

examples.text: Une pincée de piment doux donne tout de suite du relief à cette soupe de légumes.
examples.trans: A pinch of mild chili pepper immediately gives depth to this vegetable soup.

examples.text: La lumière du soir met joliment en relief les pierres de la vieille église.
examples.trans: The evening light nicely brings out the texture of the old church's stones.

meanings.note: To bind the pages of a book in cloth or leather ('relié en toile'); to connect two points.

examples.text: Ce vieux guide de plantes est relié en toile verte.
examples.trans: This old plant guide is bound in green cloth.

examples.text: Quatre cordes dorées relient le balcon du premier étage au tilleul.
examples.trans: Four golden cords connect the second-floor balcony to the linden tree.

related.gloss: cover (of a magazine or book); blanket

meanings.note: To read a letter, clue, or proof a second time.

examples.text: Relisons l'énigme lentement pour ne manquer aucun détail.
examples.trans: Let's reread the riddle slowly so we don't miss a single detail.

examples.text: J'aime relire ce roman chaque été sous le tilleul.
examples.trans: I love rereading this novel every summer under the linden tree.

relâcher.gloss: to release, to relax, to let go

meanings.note: Tirez, relâchez = pull, release. Regular -er verb; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'relâché').
Regular -er verb; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'relâché').

examples.text: Respire profondément et essaie de relâcher tes épaules quelques secondes.
examples.trans: Breathe deeply and try to relax your shoulders for a few seconds.

examples.text: Après avoir soigné son aile blessée, nous avons relâché l'oiseau dans le jardin.
examples.trans: After treating its injured wing, we released the bird into the garden.

meanings.en: prendre la relève = to take over
meanings.note: Prendre la relève means taking over duties from someone else, not buying a company.

examples.text: J'ai cuisiné tout le matin, maintenant mon frère prend la relève!
examples.trans: I cooked all morning, now my brother is taking over!

examples.text: Quand ma mère est fatiguée de conduire, mon père assure la relève.
examples.trans: When my mother gets tired of driving, my father takes over.

meanings.note: Un travail remarquable. Adjective of capability/quality formed with '-able'/'-ible' (from Latin '-abilis'/'-ibilis'). Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity.

examples.text: Le boulanger de notre rue fait une brioche aux pralines absolument remarquable.
examples.trans: The baker on our street makes an absolutely outstanding praline brioche.

examples.text: À quatre-vingts ans, notre voisin garde une mémoire vraiment remarquable!
examples.trans: At eighty years old, our neighbor keeps a truly remarkable memory!

meanings.note: To a striking or remarkable degree.
Built from remarquable ('remarkable') + -ment.

examples.text: Hé! Ce monsieur distingué près du portail est remarquablement élégant, merci beaucoup!
examples.trans: Hey! That distinguished gentleman near the gate is remarkably handsome, thank you very much!

examples.text: Après trente ans sous la pierre, la boussole fonctionne remarquablement bien.
examples.trans: After thirty years under the stone, the compass works remarkably well.

meanings.note: Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Standard feminine noun meaning 'remark, comment'.

examples.text: Ta remarque sur les horaires du bus est très juste, il faut vérifier.
examples.trans: Your comment about the bus schedule is very fair, we need to check.

examples.text: Le professeur a écrit une remarque encourageante en haut de sa copie.
examples.trans: The teacher wrote an encouraging remark at the top of her paper.

meanings.note: remarquer un détail = to notice a detail

examples.text: Personne ne remarque le changement.
examples.trans: Nobody notices the change.

examples.text: Elle a remarqué mon absence.
examples.trans: She noticed my absence.

meanings.note: Demander un remboursement = to ask for a refund.

examples.text: Alors? Il a crié? Il a demandé un remboursement?
examples.trans: Well? Did he shout? Did he ask for a refund?

examples.text: J'ai reçu le remboursement de mes lunettes sur mon compte ce matin.
examples.trans: I received the reimbursement for my glasses in my account this morning.

meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to reimburse'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'remboursé').

examples.text: Tu as avancé l'argent des billets de train? Je te rembourse tout de suite!
examples.trans: Did you front the money for the train tickets? I'll pay you back right away!

examples.text: Le magasin accepte de rembourser ce pull si tu as gardé le ticket de caisse.
examples.trans: The store agrees to refund this sweater if you kept the receipt.

meanings.note: remercier quelqu'un de/pour quelque chose

examples.text: Nous avons offert des fleurs à la voisine pour la remercier chaleureusement.
examples.trans: We gave flowers to the neighbor to thank her warmly.

examples.text: Je te remercie beaucoup pour ce bon gâteau aux noix fait maison.
examples.trans: Thank you very much for this good homemade walnut cake.

meanings.en: to put back in place, reseat
meanings.note: Conjugated exactly like *mettre* (*j'ai remis*).

examples.text: Il remet le petit axe en laiton à sa place avec précaution.
examples.trans: He carefully puts the small brass pin back in place.

examples.text: Remettez le couvercle sur le pot pour garder le sucre au sec.
examples.trans: Put the lid back on the jar to keep the sugar dry.

remonter.gloss: to spring back, rise again; go back up

meanings.en: to spring back up (of kneaded dough); to go back upstairs
meanings.note: La pâte remonte toute seule = the dough springs right back.

examples.text: Quand la pâte est prête, elle remonte doucement sous le doigt.
examples.trans: When the dough is ready, it springs gently back under your finger.

examples.text: Je remonte chercher mon violon dans la chambre quatre.
examples.trans: I am going back upstairs to get my violin from Room 4.

meanings.note: Put someone or something in another's place.
Can refer to a temporary stand-in as well as a permanent replacement.

examples.text: Dans ce gâteau, on peut facilement remplacer le beurre par de la compote de pommes.
examples.trans: In this cake, you can easily replace the butter with applesauce.

examples.text: Ma collègue est grippée, alors je la remplace à l'accueil toute la journée.
examples.trans: My coworker has the flu, so I'm filling in for her at the front desk all day.

meanings.note: Feminine: remplaçante.

examples.text: Notre dentiste est absent cette semaine, mais son remplaçant est très doux.
examples.trans: Our dentist is away this week, but his substitute is very gentle.

examples.text: Les élèves ont accueilli le nouveau professeur remplaçant avec curiosité.
examples.trans: The students welcomed the new substitute teacher with curiosity.

meanings.note: French '-ir' verb (from Latin '-ire') meaning 'to fill up'; essential in everyday spoken and professional French.

examples.text: La salle est déjà bien remplie.
examples.trans: The hall is already well filled.

examples.text: Il remplit son verre d'eau.
examples.trans: He fills his glass of water.

examples.text: Je tourne doucement... écoutez! L'eau remplit le tuyau!
examples.trans: Turning slowly... listen! Water is filling the pipe!

remporter.gloss: to win, carry off, take away

meanings.en: to win an award or victory
meanings.note: Remporter un prix / la victoire. Regular -er verb; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'remporté').
Remporter ses affaires. Regular -er verb; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'remporté').

examples.text: Notre petite équipe de quartier a remporté le tournoi de pétanque hier soir!
examples.trans: Our little neighborhood team won the petanque tournament last night!

examples.text: S'il reste du gâteau après la fête, chacun pourra en remporter une part chez soi.
examples.trans: If there is cake left after the party, everyone can take a slice back home.

meanings.en: to stir (paint, soup, tea); to wiggle, move
meanings.note: Standard everyday verb for stirring a pot of soup or a tin of paint before use (*remuer la peinture*).

examples.text: Remuez bien la peinture avec une baguette en bois avant de commencer.
examples.trans: Stir the paint well with a wooden stick before starting.

examples.text: Laissez cuire la soupe à feu doux en remuant de temps en temps.
examples.trans: Let the soup cook over low heat, stirring occasionally.

meanings.en: A widespread French family name (and historical masculine given name) of Frankish origin, identical in form to the French common noun renard ("fox").
meanings.note: Final -d is silent in isolation (ʁənaʁ), though etymological -t/-d surfaces in derivatives of the common noun such as renarde ("vixen") and renardeau ("fox cub").

examples.text: Madame Renard tient une petite librairie dans notre rue.
examples.trans: Mrs. Renard runs a small bookshop on our street.

examples.text: J'ai laissé le dossier sur le bureau de monsieur Renard.
examples.trans: I left the folder on Mr. Renard's desk.

meanings.en: Renaud (French male given name and surname)
meanings.note: Traditional French masculine given name that also became a widespread family name across France.

examples.text: Renaud prend un café chaud avant d'aller au travail.
examples.trans: Renaud is having a hot coffee before going to work.

examples.text: Tu sais à quelle heure Renaud arrive à la gare?
examples.trans: Do you know what time Renaud arrives at the train station?

meanings.note: Faire une rencontre. Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Standard feminine noun meaning 'meeting, encounter'.

examples.text: Quelle belle rencontre nous avons faite dans le train pour Marseille!
examples.trans: What a lovely person we met on the train to Marseille!

examples.text: Je vais à la gare à la rencontre de mes grands-parents qui arrivent à midi.
examples.trans: I'm going to the station to meet my grandparents who arrive at noon.

meanings.note: For meeting someone, often for the first time or by chance; not necessarily an arranged appointment.

examples.text: On s'est rencontrés à Paris.
examples.trans: We met in Paris.

examples.text: C'était mon plan lâche de lundi... avant de vous rencontrer tous.
examples.trans: That was my cowardly Monday plan... before meeting all of you.

meanings.note: avoir rendez-vous avec = to have an appointment with

examples.text: J'ai un rendez-vous chez le dentiste demain matin à neuf heures précises.
examples.trans: I have an appointment at the dentist tomorrow morning at nine o'clock sharp.

examples.text: Nous avons rendez-vous devant la fontaine du parc après le travail.
examples.trans: We are meeting in front of the park fountain after work.

rendre.gloss: to give back, to return; to make (someone happy/sad)

meanings.note: Rendre quelque chose à quelqu'un.
Rendre service = to do a favour.

examples.text: Parce que le bon café et le pain chaud rendent les gens sympas!
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people friendly!

examples.text: Personne ne fixe les clients. On rend le sac et on fait son travail.
examples.trans: Nobody stares at guests. We hand back the bag and do our job.

examples.text: Rends-moi mon livre.
examples.trans: Give me back my book.

meanings.note: Encountered in French primarily as a family name of Romance (Spanish, Italian, or respelled French) origin.

examples.text: Monsieur Reno travaille au deuxième étage de cet immeuble.
examples.trans: Mr. Reno works on the second floor of this building.

examples.text: J'ai réservé une grande table au restaurant pour la famille Reno.
examples.trans: I reserved a large table at the restaurant for the Reno family.

meanings.en: to give up, surrender, renounce (renoncer à)
meanings.note: Regular -er verb; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'renoncé').

examples.text: À cause de l'orage, nous avons dû renoncer à notre pique-nique au bord du lac.
examples.trans: Because of the thunderstorm, we had to give up on our picnic by the lake.

examples.text: Je ne pourrais jamais renoncer à mon petit café chaud du matin!
examples.trans: I could never give up my hot morning coffee!

meanings.en: se renseigner = to find out, inquire
meanings.note: Reflexive. Regular -er verb; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'renseigné').

meanings.en: renseigner quelqu'un = to give someone information
meanings.note: Regular -er verb; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'renseigné').

examples.text: Je vais me renseigner au guichet pour connaître le prix d'un abonnement mensuel.
examples.trans: I'm going to inquire at the ticket window to find out the price of a monthly pass.

examples.text: Bonjour madame, pouvez-vous me renseigner sur les horaires de la bibliothèque?
examples.trans: Hello ma'am, could you give me information about the library's hours?

rentrer.gloss: to go home, to come back

meanings.en: to go home, to get back
meanings.note: Uses être in the compound past when it means returning home.

meanings.en: to go in, to come in
meanings.note: Informal for entrer.

examples.text: On est rentrés chez moi.
examples.trans: We went back to my place.

examples.text: Rentrez vite vos vélos dans le garage, il va pleuvoir très fort!
examples.trans: Bring your bikes inside the garage quickly, it's going to rain really hard!

meanings.en: to spill (a drink), tip or knock over
meanings.note: Covers both knocking over a cup and spilling the liquid inside (*renverser son café*).

examples.text: Attention à ne pas renverser votre tasse de café sur le carnet!
examples.trans: Careful not to spill your cup of coffee on the notebook!

examples.text: Le vent a presque renversé le petit pot de fleurs.
examples.trans: The wind nearly knocked over the small flowerpot.

renvoyer.gloss: to fire, to dismiss, to send back

meanings.en: to fire, to dismiss; to send back
meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to fire'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'renvoyé').

examples.text: Renvoyer un employé.
examples.trans: To dismiss an employee.

examples.text: Merci à vous deux d'avoir été honnêtes au lieu de me renvoyer sous la pluie.
examples.trans: Thank you both for being honest instead of sending me back into the rain.

meanings.note: En reparler plus tard. Regular -er verb; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'reparlé').

examples.text: Là, je suis pressé, mais on en reparle tranquillement ce soir à table!
examples.trans: Right now I'm in a hurry, but let's talk about it again calmly tonight at dinner!

examples.text: Depuis leur réconciliation, les deux cousines se reparlent tous les jours.
examples.trans: Since making up, the two cousins have been speaking to each other again every day.

repartir.gloss: set off again; start from scratch

meanings.en: to leave again, set off again; to start afresh (repartir de zéro)
meanings.note: French '-ir' verb (from Latin '-ire'). Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Core French verb meaning 'set off again; start from scratch'.

examples.text: On repart de zéro.
examples.trans: We are starting from scratch.

examples.text: Même s'il fait demi-tour et repart tout droit par le portail.
examples.trans: Even if he turns around and walks straight back out the gate.

meanings.en: meal (food eaten at a regular occasion)
meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le repas', plural 'les repas').

examples.text: Le dimanche midi, ma mère prépare toujours un grand repas chaud pour toute la famille.
examples.trans: At noon on Sundays, my mother always cooks a big hot meal for the whole family.

examples.text: Après un bon repas entre amis, j'aime prendre une tisane au salon.
examples.trans: After a good meal with friends, I like having an herbal tea in the living room.

meanings.note: Repasser une cravate / une chemise.

examples.text: Quinze ans à frotter des clés en laiton et à repasser mes cravates... finis en trente jours!
examples.trans: Fifteen years polishing brass keys and ironing my ties... gone in thirty days!

examples.text: Je dois repasser ma chemise blanche avant de partir au bureau demain matin.
examples.trans: I have to iron my white shirt before leaving for the office tomorrow morning.

meanings.note: Conjugates like peindre: je repeins, nous repeignons.

examples.text: Sûrement un avis ennuyeux pour repeindre les volets sur la rue.
examples.trans: Probably a boring notice about repainting the street shutters.

examples.text: Nous allons repeindre les murs de la cuisine en blanc ce week-end.
examples.trans: We are going to repaint the kitchen walls white this weekend.

meanings.note: repenser à un souvenir = to think back to a memory

examples.text: Je repense souvent à nos vacances d'été au bord de la mer.
examples.trans: I often think back to our summer holidays by the sea.

examples.text: Quand j'y repense, ce petit hôtel près de la gare était vraiment calme.
examples.trans: When I think back on it, that little hotel near the station was really quiet.

meanings.note: To fold a map, letter, or tablecloth neatly back along its creases.

examples.text: Je replie la carte suivant ses plis d'origine.
examples.trans: I fold the map back along its original creases.

examples.text: Quand l'averse cesse, on replie les grands parapluies.
examples.trans: When the shower stops, everyone folds up the big umbrellas.

meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to dive back'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'replongé').
Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to fall back into'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'replongé').

examples.text: Les enfants ont couru sur la plage avant de replonger dans les vagues.
examples.trans: The children ran along the beach before diving back into the waves.

examples.text: Après le dîner, ma mère s'est tout de suite replongée dans son roman.
examples.trans: After dinner, my mother immediately plunged back into her novel.

meanings.en: to postpone, to defer, to reschedule
meanings.note: Regular -er verb; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'reporté').

examples.text: À cause de la pluie, nous avons dû reporter le pique-nique à dimanche prochain.
examples.trans: Because of the rain, we had to postpone the picnic until next Sunday.

examples.text: J'ai appelé le cabinet médical pour reporter mon rendez-vous à jeudi.
examples.trans: I called the medical office to reschedule my appointment for Thursday.

meanings.note: avoir besoin de repos = to need rest

examples.text: Le médecin lui a conseillé trois jours de repos complet à la maison.
examples.trans: The doctor advised him to take three days of complete rest at home.

examples.text: Profite bien de ton jour de repos pour lire et te détendre au jardin!
examples.trans: Make the most of your day off to read and relax in the garden!

meanings.en: to rest; se reposer = to rest oneself
meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to rest'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'reposé').

examples.text: Après avoir bêché tout le potager, mon grand-père va se reposer.
examples.trans: After digging the whole vegetable garden, my grandfather is going to rest.

examples.text: Repose-toi un peu sur le canapé pendant que je prépare le dîner.
examples.trans: Rest a bit on the couch while I make dinner.

reprendre.gloss: to take back; to start again, to pick up

meanings.en: to start again, to resume, to pick up
meanings.note: Les affaires reprennent.

meanings.en: to take back, to have more of

examples.text: On reprend le travail.
examples.trans: We're going back to work.

examples.text: Reprendre mon souffle? Jamais!
examples.trans: Catch my breath? Never!

meanings.en: to reproach, to criticize someone for something
meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to reproach'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'reproché').

examples.text: Qu'est-ce que tu me reproches exactement?
examples.trans: What exactly are you blaming me for?

examples.text: Ma sœur me reproche toujours d'oublier mon parapluie quand il pleut.
examples.trans: My sister always criticizes me for forgetting my umbrella when it rains.

meanings.note: Masculine counterpart: un représentant.

examples.text: La représentante de la mairie visite la cour à quinze heures.
examples.trans: The City Hall representative visits the courtyard at three p.m.

examples.text: Nous accueillons la représentante du quartier avec du thé chaud.
examples.trans: We welcome the neighborhood representative with hot tea.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la représentation', plural 'les représentations').

examples.text: La dernière représentation de la pièce commence à vingt heures précises.
examples.trans: The final performance of the play starts at eight o'clock sharp.

examples.text: Les élèves préparent une petite représentation théâtrale pour la fête de l'école.
examples.trans: The students are preparing a short theatrical show for the school fair.

meanings.note: An agent represents an actor.

examples.text: Ce vieux pont en pierre représente toute l'histoire de notre ville.
examples.trans: This old stone bridge represents the whole history of our town.

examples.text: Le loyer représente presque la moitié de mon budget chaque mois.
examples.trans: Rent represents almost half of my budget every month.

meanings.note: Repérer de nouveaux talents. Regular -er verb; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'repéré').

examples.text: J'ai vite repéré une petite table libre au soleil sur la terrasse du café.
examples.trans: I quickly spotted a free little table in the sun on the café terrace.

examples.text: Tu arrives à repérer notre voiture au fond de ce grand parking?
examples.trans: Can you spot our car at the back of this big parking lot?

meanings.note: Also a ruthless person.

examples.text: Les enfants ont observé un petit requin dans le grand bassin de l'aquarium.
examples.trans: The children watched a small shark in the large tank at the aquarium.

examples.text: Mon cousin a toujours peur des requins quand il nage loin de la plage.
examples.trans: My cousin is always afraid of sharks when he swims far from the beach.

meanings.note: Final ct is silent.

examples.text: Par respect pour nos voisins, nous baissons le son de la télévision le soir.
examples.trans: Out of respect for our neighbours, we turn down the television volume in the evening.

examples.text: Le boulanger parle toujours à ses clients avec beaucoup de respect.
examples.trans: The baker always speaks to his customers with great respect.

meanings.note: Respect a person, decision or rule; takes its object directly.

examples.text: Je respecte votre décision.
examples.trans: I respect your decision.

examples.text: Il respecte ses clients.
examples.trans: He respects his clients.

examples.text: Non, Claire, soyons francs! Monsieur, nous respectons beaucoup le Guide de Lyon!
examples.trans: No, Claire, let us be frank! Sir, we deeply respect the Lyon Guide!

meanings.note: Figurative: une respiration. Feminine action/state noun from Latin '-tio'/'-sio'. Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Standard feminine noun meaning 'breathing, breath, breather'.

examples.text: Après avoir monté les cinq étages à pied, ma respiration était très rapide.
examples.trans: After walking up the five floors, my breathing was very fast.

examples.text: Prends une grande respiration avant de plonger la tête sous l'eau.
examples.trans: Take a deep breath before putting your head underwater.

examples.text: Respire calmement.
examples.trans: Breathe calmly.

examples.text: Ouvre un peu la fenêtre du salon, on a besoin de respirer de l'air frais!
examples.trans: Open the living room window a bit, we need to breathe some fresh air!

meanings.note: A strong compliment.

examples.text: La mariée était resplendissante dans sa belle robe en dentelle blanche.
examples.trans: The bride looked radiant in her lovely white lace dress.

examples.text: Après quinze jours de vacances à la montagne, tu as l'air resplendissant!
examples.trans: After two weeks of holiday in the mountains, you look glowing!

meanings.note: Feminine abstract noun formed with '-ité' (from Latin '-itas', English '-ity'). Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Standard feminine noun meaning 'responsibility'.

examples.text: Adopter un jeune chien à la maison, c'est une vraie responsabilité quotidienne.
examples.trans: Adopting a young dog at home is a real daily responsibility.

examples.text: La directrice a pris toute la responsabilité de ce changement d'horaire.
examples.trans: The manager took full responsibility for this schedule change.

meanings.note: Responsable de = responsible for. Adjective of capability/quality formed with '-able'/'-ible' (from Latin '-abilis'/'-ibilis'). Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity.

examples.text: Pas touche, Nadia! Claire, voulez-vous rester comme responsable de la réception pour de bon?
examples.trans: Hands off, Nadia! Claire, would you stay as permanent front-desk manager?

examples.text: Il est responsable du projet.
examples.trans: He is responsible for the project.

meanings.note: ressembler à quelqu'un = to look like someone (indirect object: lui ressembler)

examples.text: Ma petite sœur ressemble beaucoup à notre mère sur cette vieille photo.
examples.trans: My little sister looks a lot like our mother in this old photo.

examples.text: Ce gros nuage blanc au-dessus du toit ressemble vraiment à un mouton!
examples.trans: That big white cloud above the roof really looks like a sheep!

meanings.note: Éprouver du ressentiment. Masculine action/result noun formed with the Romance suffix '-ment' (from Latin '-mentum'). Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Standard masculine noun meaning 'resentment, grievance'.

examples.text: Malgré leur vieille dispute, il n'éprouve aucun ressentiment envers son frère.
examples.trans: Despite their old argument, he feels no resentment toward his brother.

examples.text: Se parler franchement autour d'un café évite bien des ressentiments inutiles.
examples.trans: Speaking frankly over a coffee avoids a lot of pointless resentment.

meanings.en: to feel, experience, perceive (a sensation or emotion)
meanings.note: French '-ir' verb (from Latin '-ire') meaning 'to feel'; essential in everyday spoken and professional French.

examples.text: On ressent une douce chaleur dès qu'on entre dans la boulangerie.
examples.trans: You feel a gentle warmth as soon as you step into the bakery.

examples.text: Je ressens déjà une grande fatigue après avoir nettoyé toutes les fenêtres.
examples.trans: I already feel great tiredness after cleaning all the windows.

meanings.note: Resserrer une vis = to tighten a screw.

examples.text: Attention à cette chaise du coin, attendez dix secondes, je resserre cette vis.
examples.trans: Watch that corner chair, wait ten seconds while I tighten this screw.

examples.text: Le vent est glacial ce matin, resserre bien ton écharpe autour du cou.
examples.trans: The wind is freezing this morning, tighten your scarf snugly around your neck.

ressortir.gloss: to come out again, to resurface

meanings.en: to come out again, resurface, emerge
meanings.note: French '-ir' verb (from Latin '-ire'). Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Core French verb meaning 'to come out again, to resurface'.

examples.text: Je viens à peine de rentrer des courses et je dois déjà ressortir promener le chien.
examples.trans: I barely just got home from grocery shopping and I already have to go out again to walk the dog.

examples.text: Le soleil ressort enfin derrière les nuages après toute une matinée de pluie.
examples.trans: The sun is finally coming out again from behind the clouds after a whole morning of rain.

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le restaurant', plural 'les restaurants').

examples.text: On dîne dans ce petit restaurant près de la place du marché ce soir?
examples.trans: Shall we have dinner at that little restaurant near the market square tonight?

examples.text: Ce restaurant familial propose un menu différent chaque midi avec des produits frais.
examples.trans: This family restaurant offers a different lunch menu every day with fresh produce.

meanings.en: to restore (a historic room, painting, or instrument)
meanings.note: Restaurer un jardin d'hiver = restore a historic sunroom.

examples.text: Ils ont restauré le jardin d'hiver sans toucher aux arches.
examples.trans: They restored the sunroom without altering the arches.

examples.text: Le luthier restaure un violon vieux de cent ans.
examples.trans: The luthier is restoring a hundred-year-old violin.

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le reste', plural 'les restes').

examples.text: J'ai mis les restes du poulet rôti au réfrigérateur pour le déjeuner de demain.
examples.trans: I put the leftover roast chicken in the fridge for tomorrow's lunch.

examples.text: Nous avons passé le reste du dimanche à marcher le long de la rivière.
examples.trans: We spent the rest of Sunday walking along the river.

meanings.note: Passé composé with être.

examples.text: Comme il pleut très fort dehors, nous préférons rester au chaud.
examples.trans: Since it is raining very hard outside, we prefer staying somewhere warm.

examples.text: Il reste encore une belle part de quiche au fromage au réfrigérateur.
examples.trans: There is still a nice slice of cheese quiche left in the refrigerator.

meanings.note: Être en retard.

examples.text: Le train a dix minutes de retard à cause de la neige.
examples.trans: The train is ten minutes late because of the snow.

examples.text: Je suis désolé d'être en retard, il y avait beaucoup de circulation.
examples.trans: I am sorry for being late, there was a lot of traffic.

meanings.note: Une bombe à retardement.

examples.text: La fatigue du déménagement a eu un effet à retardement le lundi matin.
examples.trans: The tiredness from moving house had a delayed effect on Monday morning.

examples.text: Cette fuite d'eau sous le vieil évier était une véritable bombe à retardement.
examples.trans: That water leak under the old sink was a real time bomb.

meanings.en: to remember, to keep in mind
meanings.note: Retenez is the polite/plural command: remember or keep in mind.

examples.text: Je ne retiens jamais les dates.
examples.trans: I never remember dates.

examples.text: Bonjour Thibault, merci d'être venu. D'accord, je peux retenir ça.
examples.trans: Hello Thibault, thank you for coming. Okay, I can remember that.

retirer.gloss: to pull back, to take off, to withdraw

meanings.en: to remove, pull back, take off
meanings.note: Retirer son manteau = to take off one's coat.

meanings.en: to withdraw (money) or pick up (a parcel)
meanings.note: Retirer de l'argent / retirer un colis.

meanings.en: se retirer = to withdraw, step back
meanings.note: Pronominal construction conjugated with être.

cells: il s'est retiré / elle s'est retirée
ils se sont retirés / elles se sont retirées

examples.text: Il retire sa veste.
examples.trans: He takes off his jacket.

examples.text: L'acheteur se retire.
examples.trans: The buyer pulls out.

meanings.en: to fall again, land (retomber sur ses pieds = land on one's feet)
meanings.note: Regular -er verb; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'retombé').

examples.text: La neige commence à retomber doucement sur les toits du village.
examples.trans: Snow is starting to fall again gently on the village roofs.

examples.text: Ne t'inquiète pas pour ta sœur, elle retombe toujours sur ses pieds!
examples.trans: Don't worry about your sister, she always lands on her feet!

meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to retouch photos or text'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'retouché').

examples.text: Le photographe a légèrement retouché la lumière sur nos photos de vacances.
examples.trans: The photographer slightly retouched the lighting on our holiday photos.

examples.text: Je dois encore retoucher deux phrases de ma lettre avant de l'imprimer.
examples.trans: I still need to touch up two sentences in my letter before printing it.

meanings.note: Sur le chemin du retour = 'on the way back'; être de retour = 'to be back'.

examples.text: Nous serons de retour du marché avant midi.
examples.trans: We will be back from the market before noon.

examples.text: Prenez le parapluie pour le chemin du retour.
examples.trans: Take the umbrella for the walk back.

meanings.en: to go back, to return (conjugated with être)

examples.text: Il est retourné à Paris.
examples.trans: He went back to Paris.

examples.text: Excusez-moi, madame, je retourne à mon bureau avec dignité!
examples.trans: Excuse me, madam, I am going back to my office with dignity!

meanings.note: Retirement from work ('à la retraite' = retired; 'prendre sa retraite' = retire); peaceful haven.

examples.text: Depuis sa retraite, l'ancien professeur peint tous les matins.
examples.trans: Since retiring, the former professor paints every morning.

examples.text: Ce jardin calme est une vraie retraite au cœur de la ville.
examples.trans: This quiet garden is a true retreat in the heart of town.

retrousser.gloss: to roll up (sleeves); to tuck up

meanings.en: to roll up (sleeves); to tuck up
meanings.note: 'retrousser ses manches' = to roll up one's sleeves and get to work.

examples.text: Les apprentis entrent dans la cuisine avec les manches retroussées.
examples.trans: The apprentices step into the kitchen with their sleeves rolled up.

examples.text: Retroussez vos manches avant de pétrir la pâte aux amandes!
